newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at Brazil Paranagua/Santos.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at Brazil Paranagua/Santos.

text.p: Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soyproducts.
Vessels: Grace loading 55,500 tonnes soybeans, Evmar loading 22,000 tonnes soymeal, Sea Pier loading 5,300 tonnes soymeal, Ionis loading 21,640 tonnes soymeal, New Wave loading 41,293 tonnes soymeal
Waiting to dock: 10 vessels to load soymeal, two to load soybeans, two to load soybeans/meal
Road: 960 trucks carrying soybeans arrived on May 20, 414 trucks with soymeal and 94 trucks with vegetable oils including soyoil
Loaded (May 20): 18,239 tonnes soybeans, 20,720 tonnes soymeal Stocks: No figures available
Vessels: At Cargill private terminal, Flag Klarin loading 28,000 tonnes soybeans
Road: 246 trucks unloaded 6,443 tonnes soybeans on May 20 and 42 trucks unloaded 1,160 tonnes soymeal
